# OnFinality
> OnFinality provides reliable multichain RPC APIs and dedicated blockchain nodes for production Web3 teams.

<!-- Automatically generated from the site's content configuration during each build. Do not edit this file directly. -->

## OnFinality in numbers
- 130+ supported blockchain networks
- 1,000+ Projects Supported
- 99.99% Infrastructure Reliability
- 28 Bn+ API Requests Served
- 300 Bn+ Onchain Data Points Processed

## Core product pages
- [RPC Provider Comparison Guides](https://onfinality.io/en/compare): Network-specific RPC selection guides for Ethereum, Bittensor, and Sui, with documented pricing, features, and existing provider comparisons.
- [Blockchain RPC API Service](https://onfinality.io/en/api-service): Managed multichain RPC APIs for dApps, wallets, DeFi products, games, analytics tools, and backend services.
- [Supported Networks](https://onfinality.io/en/networks): Mainnet and testnet networks supported by OnFinality RPC APIs and dedicated node infrastructure.
- [RPC API Pricing](https://onfinality.io/en/pricing/rpc): RPC plans, free Developer access, response units, rate limits, and upgrade paths.
- [Dedicated Nodes](https://onfinality.io/en/dedicated-node): Dedicated blockchain node infrastructure for isolated resources and custom node requirements.
- [RPC Assistant](https://onfinality.io/en/rpc-assistant): Answers about RPC providers, endpoints, testnets, rate limits, troubleshooting, and production Web3 infrastructure.
- [OnFinality Learn](https://onfinality.io/en/learn): Technical guides for blockchain RPC, nodes, Web3 infrastructure, and application reliability.
- [Enterprise Node Infrastructure](https://onfinality.io/en/enterprise-node): Enterprise blockchain infrastructure and managed node solutions.
- [Contact OnFinality](https://onfinality.io/en/contact-us): Contact the OnFinality team about RPC APIs, dedicated nodes, and enterprise infrastructure.

About OnFinality

What is OnFinality?

OnFinality is a blockchain infrastructure platform for Web3 teams that need reliable access to many networks without operating nodes themselves. The platform combines production RPC APIs, dedicated blockchain nodes, indexing services, staking and validator infrastructure, network prototyping tools, and AI-powered support. Developers use OnFinality to connect wallets, dApps, DeFi products, games, analytics systems, and enterprise workflows to more than 130 blockchain networks through managed infrastructure. The main value is operational leverage: teams can launch faster, monitor usage, scale traffic, and move from shared RPC access to dedicated infrastructure when workloads become more demanding. OnFinality is especially useful for teams that need multichain coverage, predictable uptime, request analytics, archive or Trace API options, and hands-on infrastructure support without hiring a large DevOps team. This makes it a practical fit for production applications, ecosystem teams, and startups that need infrastructure reliability before they scale.
